rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance Source of Income Protection
rules.requirement: Landlords and housing providers are prohibited from discriminating against applicants or tenants based on their source of income, which includes Section 8 and public benefits.

coverage.summary: Covers housing and real estate transactions in Cambridge, with an exemption for 2-family dwellings where the owner lives.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts 2-family dwellings when the owner lives on the property.

rules.exemptions: 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
